faqs.a: We're sorry you're dealing with this. Frank Penney Injury Law handles car accident claims across California - paperwork, insurance calls, and negotiations included. Call (888) 888-0566 for a free consultation, or leave your details here and we'll contact you within 24 hours.

faqs.a: Tell us about your case and we'll contact you within 24 hours. You can also call (888) 888-0566 any time - we're available 24/7.

faqs.a: Frank Penney Injury Law has recovered over $1 billion for injury victims, with 30+ years of experience and 10,000+ cases won. Past results never guarantee a future outcome - every case is different.
We have 11 locations across California - offices in Roseville, Stockton, Sacramento, Fairfield, Modesto, Chico, and Oakland, plus additional service areas.
Personal injury cases - car, motorcycle, truck, and pedestrian accidents, wrongful death, and other serious injury claims. If you're not sure your case fits, ask us - the consultation is free.
